clues.title: Plate: white with red on the left
text: Mongolian licence plates are mostly white with a hint of **red** on the left side from the [Soyombo symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soyombo_symbol).

images.caption: Mongolian plates: standard long and short

clues.summary: White plates with a hint of red on the left, from a national symbol printed there.

clues.title: Language: Cyrillic with extra letters Ө and Ү
text: Mongolia primarily uses **Cyrillic **script, though [Latin](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.912178,106.980081,3a,17.5y,297.7h,98.09t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s5Bf-6kOlFPU1X7Sd37ewaw!2e0) and [traditional Mongolian](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.0335237,111.6546939,2a,63.5y,344.76h,97.65t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3xuVpyvGy0UEgWOxX2rmTA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) script can also occasionally be seen. Mongolian Cyrillic contains the letters **Ɵ** and **Ү**,** **which do not exist in the Russian alphabet. Additionally, the use of **double vowels**,** **such as aa, ƟƟ or ЭЭ, is common in Mongolian.
NOTE: The letters **Ɵ** and **Ү **also exist in the Kyrgyz and Kazakh languages.

images.caption: Mongolian Cyrillic text sample with extra letters Ө and Ү

clues.summary: Mostly Cyrillic script, with Ө and Ү (not in Russian) and many double vowels like aa, ӨӨ, ЭЭ. Latin and the old vertical script appear occasionally. Kyrgyz and Kazakh also use Ө and Ү.

differs.how: Russian has no Ө or Ү

clues.title: Google car: big pickup with tent, red mirrors, snorkel
text: Mongolia very often has a visible Street View car as all of Mongolian coverage was driven with a large pickup truck. The truck can have several features such as a **tent **on top, **red** **side-view mirrors**, a **snorkel,** and **roof-racks.** All of these can be of help in identifying Mongolia.
clues.summary: All coverage was shot from a big pickup truck that is often visible: a tent on top, red side mirrors, a raised antenna pipe (snorkel) and roof racks.

clues.title: Landscape: treeless grassland steppe or desert
text: Mongolia can typically be identified by the **steppe biomes** found across the country. While some forested areas are found in Mongolia, most of the country features empty grasslands or deserts with a characteristic **lack of trees**. It is not uncommon to find rugged, rocky or rolling hills as well as rivers and lakes across Mongolia.
clues.summary: Steppe: empty grassland or desert with almost no trees, plus rugged rocky or rolling hills, rivers and lakes. Some forest exists but most of the country is open.

clues.title: Bollard: white bowling pin with two red stripes
text: Mongolia uniquely features white **bowling-pin shaped bollards** with two red stripes around the top.
clues.summary: A white bowling-pin-shaped bollard with two red stripes round the top. Only found here.

clues.title: Pole: Russian-style wooden poles on stone blocks
text: Mongolian infrastructure has clear Russian influence. Wooden poles with supporting stone blocks, [white lamp posts](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.677839,113.270184,3a,64.1y,330.3h,92.79t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sAv0lfNtDl5QLj3rxCnkYzA!2e0), and [three-striped** **pedestrian crossing signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2393538,106.2025013,2a,60y,95.51h,75.52t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sXUNd4wtT71dkoiStvdsI-Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) are common to see.

Unique to Mongolia is the** **[**“ЗОГС”**](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2286946,106.2131419,2a,15y,73.91h,86.02t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDbSJ2KjqHFeQw_Vx-Muhyg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)** stop sign**.
NOTE: Each town has unique lamp post designs, so learning them can be quite useful.
clues.summary: Wooden poles propped by stone blocks, white lamp posts and pedestrian signs with three stripes, as in Russia. A stop sign saying ЗОГС is unique. Each town has its own lamp post design.

clues.title: Houses: dirt alleys and wooden fences
text: Mongolian neighbourhoods are very frequently separated by **dirt alleys **and wooden fences.
clues.summary: Neighbourhoods are separated by dirt alleys and wooden fences.

clues.title: Houses: white round yurts
text: White, round **yurts** are the traditional dwelling of nomadic families in Mongolia, and are often seen all around the country.
clues.summary: White round yurts, the traditional nomad home, are seen all over the country.

clues.title: Animals: big herds of horses, yaks, sheep, camels
text: It is very common to see** **large **herds of animals** in Mongolia, including horses, yaks, cows, sheep, goats, and camels.
clues.summary: Large herds of horses, yaks, cows, sheep, goats and camels are very common.

clues.title: Landmark: decorated stone piles (ovoos)
text: Decorated piles of stones, known as **[ovoos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ovoo)**, are used as ceremonial markers or shrines throughout Mongolia and are common to see.
clues.summary: Piles of stones, often decorated, used as ceremonial markers or shrines. Common everywhere.

clues.title: Coverage: very limited, mostly highways and big towns
text: Mongolia has very **limited coverage**, mainly along highways and in large towns. Learning which roads and towns have coverage can be very useful. The highest coverage density can be found around the capital of Ulaanbaatar.
NOTE: Mongolia has lots of hidden coverage that will generally not be discussed in the guide.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Coverage is very sparse, mainly highways and large towns, with the most around the capital. Learn which roads have coverage.

clues.title: Coverage: driving away from the capital
text: Driving directions can be a very useful clue for narrowing down your location in Mongolia. In general, the driving direction tends to be **away** from Ulaanbaatar.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Driving direction is a useful clue: you generally drive away from the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: flat east and south, hills north, peaks west
text: Mongolia has a very flat landscape in the [east](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.73666,115.619004,3a,133.2y,131.8h,89.73t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPMeGOJzhTczd2N48yJO0SA!2e0) and in the [south](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.625866,110.189335,3a,133.2y,106.3h,88.33t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1suf4vmx84-FxMBRMs_8-nXw!2e0), with rolling hills in the [north](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.670421,107.38073,3a,133.2y,14.0h,90.81t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sJUXSwULUB8Oyo71A1jzpjw!2e0), and large mountains and rocky hills being common in the [west](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.3651208,91.9735923,2a,90y,233.82h,91.68t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1saI5LPmTsTzRoYr99i_qoHg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Very flat in the east and south, rolling hills in the north, and large mountains and rocky hills in the west.

clues.title: Plants: larch forests in the north
text: You can find **forests**, typically surrounded by grassy fields, all around northern Mongolia. Generally these will be Siberian Larches, with pines and birches being common as well.
clues.summary: In the north: forests surrounded by grass, mostly Siberian larch, with pines and birches common too.

clues.title: Road: small dirt tracks in vast grass fields
text: Small dirt tracks within flat, **vast grassy fields** are mainly found in far eastern Mongolia.
clues.summary: In the far east: small dirt tracks through flat, vast grassy fields.

clues.title: Coverage: off-road desert tracks
text: There are several areas with off-road **desert **coverage in southern Mongolia. Most of this coverage is directly south or east of the town of Mandalgovi.
clues.summary: Several areas of off-road desert coverage in the south, mostly directly south or east of one central-south town.

clues.title: Road: a couple of paved desert roads
text: There are a couple of **paved desert roads** in southern Mongolia.
_You can learn more about these roads later in the guide._
clues.summary: In the south there are a couple of paved desert roads.

clues.title: Landscape: coarse soil, patchy grass, small shrubs
text: You can find arid steppe rangeland, characterised by the **coarse soil**, **patchy grass**, and** small shrubs**, throughout southwestern Mongolia.
clues.summary: In the south-west: dry steppe with coarse soil, patchy grass and small shrubs.

clues.title: Landscape: dry rugged hills and mountains
text: These **dry**, **rugged hills and mountains** are common to see in far western Mongolia.
clues.summary: In the far west: dry, rugged hills and mountains are common.

clues.title: Landscape: more lakes and rivers in the west
text: Lakes and rivers are much more common in western Mongolia.
clues.summary: Lakes and rivers are much more common in the west.

clues.title: Coverage: snow around the capital
text: **Snow **coverage is mostly found around Ulaanbaatar.
clues.summary: Snowy coverage is mostly around the capital.

clues.title: Coverage: autumn orange grass and trees
text: Fall coverage in Mongolia gives rise to very distinct **orange-coloured trees and grass**, and can only be found in a few areas; mostly between the towns of Lun and Hatgal, with some fall coverage [around Ulaanbaatar](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.866984,107.188701,3a,133.2y,235.5h,85.21t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1saIpt9aZkRkOjlFykNBDfwg!2e0). Trees are more commonly seen the further north you are.

NOTE: Some of the generation 4 coverage in [Ulaanbaatar](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9189445,107.4492844,3a,75y,185.1h,91.89t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smK-88Jih1bfOYeF2tjMvsw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) was also taken in the fall.
clues.summary: Orange trees and grass from autumn coverage, only in a few areas: mostly in the north between two towns, plus some around the capital. More trees the further north you go. Some newer Gen 4 coverage in the capital was also shot in autumn.

clues.title: Landscape: narrow forest trails, close trees, birches
text: Around the town of Bugant is a large forest that stands out for having **narrow dirt trails** with** close trees**, typically on both sides, in a way that can appear quite Russian. Additionally, it is very common to see [birches](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.564103,107.379264,3a,133.2y,330.1h,93.54t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1syWqZgKrvLoKxZ8db1nZrRA!2e0) around this area.
Keep in mind that the dirt trails in this forest do not appear on the map.
clues.summary: A large forest with narrow dirt trails and trees close on both sides, which looks Russian. Birches are very common. These trails are not on the map.

clues.title: Landscape: rare crop fields near the capital
text: Due to Mongolia’s harsh climate and terrain, **crop fields** are rare, but they do occasionally appear in the subdivisions of Selenge and Töv,** **near Ulaanbaatar.
clues.summary: Crop fields are rare because of the harsh climate, but appear in two areas near the capital.

clues.title: Houses: big city with high-rises and yurt districts
text: The capital city, Ulaanbaatar, is by far the biggest city in Mongolia, with about 50% of the entire country's population living in it. As such, its urban development and sheer size is unlike anywhere else in Mongolia. The cityscape is bustling with many **high rise buildings**, chain stores, travelling cars, buses, and pedestrians, as well as clean roads and sidewalks. Meanwhile, the suburbs can be recognized from the [vast yurt districts](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9272927,107.008841,3a,29.5y,301.6h,86.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXiArLUQKXIXelnn6G9MXQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) in **hilly areas**. Generation 4 coverage is common, however Generation 3 [winter coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.809762,107.161727,3a,133.2y,242.8h,87.43t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sR3u-gHu194XNWIm0UrWpZw!2e0) is also common to see in the suburbs.
clues.summary: The capital holds about half the population: many high-rises, chain stores, traffic, clean roads. The suburbs are huge yurt districts on hills. Gen 4 is common, with Gen 3 winter coverage in the suburbs.

clues.title: Road: long desert highway with railway
text: The Choir Highway is the longest covered paved road in Mongolia, running from [Nalaikh](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.77658,107.232478,3a,133.2y,171.4h,93.00t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sFWvQqwHIvkCGtHsoz1mhYA!2e0) down to [Zamiin-Uud](https://www.google.com/maps/@43.716706,111.904061,3a,133.2y,314.6h,93.81t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sZbWIuL1uDQQ2yFg9dpxsnw!2e0) on the Chinese border, and is **mostly desert**. The dry brown soil, lack of vegetation, clear skies, and general flatness are all characteristic of this road. Additionally, a [railroad](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.718626,109.503585,3a,17.5y,216.0h,91.07t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQf6QlyXzxFZUV3dC4ir_1Q!2e0) runs along the entire highway, which can be seen **west **of the highway north of Sainshand, and **east **of the highway south of Sainshand. Between the towns of Sainshand and Erdene there is some [overcast coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.7715611,110.4184031,3a,90y,294.3h,90t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8C5NF-mzJwNxjCkq1w7yfQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
clues.summary: The longest paved road covered: mostly desert with dry brown soil, no plants, clear skies, flat land, and a railway along it (west of the road in the north, east in the south). Some overcast coverage in the middle.

clues.title: Road: second desert highway, cloudy, blue tent
text: The other main desert highway in Mongolia runs through Mandalgovi, and can be differentiated from the Choir Highway by its **cloudy skies**, darker pavement, and deep blue tent instead of the tentless car.
clues.summary: Another desert highway, told apart from the first by cloudy skies, darker pavement and a deep blue tent on the car instead of no tent.

clues.title: Road: extremely snowy and foggy, blue tent
text: The Mandalgovi Highway runs south of the capital and was covered during a blizzard, making it **extremely snowy and foggy.** It also has a deep blue tent, which is found along this entire road, and a flat landscape which can differentiate it from other snowy roads.
clues.summary: A road south of the capital covered during a blizzard: very snowy and foggy, deep blue tent, flat land.

clues.title: Road: late autumn, orange short grass, silver tent
text: The Millenium Road runs just west of the town of Lun, and has **late fall coverage**, combined with a dry climate that gives it characteristic **orange short grass**. The silver tent, clear skies, and general flatness with low rolling hills also help in identifying this road. The sun gradually sets as the car continues west until it becomes [sunset](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hx7e4vH93sGE2rws9) at the end of the road.
NOTE: At the end of the road, the car continues travelling northwest up to Murun on [off-road dirt trails](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KRZwwNuzZgr3XcJq6).
clues.summary: Late autumn coverage with dry orange short grass, a silver tent, clear skies and low rolling hills. The sun sets gradually as you drive west, ending in sunset. At the end the car continues north-west on dirt trails.

clues.title: Road: rolling hills, pylons, winter, no tent
text: The Darkhan-Erdenet highway can be identified by the low rolling hills, tall **transmission towers**, and occasional [crop fields](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.199075,104.896833,3a,80.7y,327.2h,92.95t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sfLxOZ--sUVPnO4LI6oW8Mg!2e0) in the area. Additionally, most of the highway has **winter coverage** with the tentless car, light snow, and yellow grass. Beware that [summer coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.115086,105.367769,3a,133.2y,119.6h,96.08t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQyoCUbxBQtmvvlBhuYG0KA!2e0) can occasionally appear in the eastern half of the road.
clues.summary: Low rolling hills, tall power pylons and sometimes crop fields. Most of it is winter coverage with a tentless car, light snow and yellow grass. Summer coverage appears sometimes in the eastern half.

clues.title: Road: dark freshly paved road in the flat east
text: The highway connecting the towns of Chinggis and Baruun-Urt stands out as one of the only **paved highways in the east**. It is considerably cloudy and the road seems freshly paved, making it a **very dark road**, combined with a mostly flat landscape.
clues.summary: One of the only paved highways in the east: cloudy, very dark newly laid asphalt, mostly flat land.

clues.title: Road: railway beside the road, river to the south
text: A **railroad** can be seen along almost the entire road to the town of Khuder in the north. It is usually very close to the road, but can occasionally be [quite far away](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VjrDU3HJC4rxDiMm8), in which case it can still be identified by the mound it is built upon. In the western half of this road, the [river](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zWSGEW8T86HyXKVo8) to the south can also be seen.
Keep in mind that this railroad does not appear on the map.
clues.summary: A railway runs along almost the whole road, usually close but sometimes far off on a raised mound. In the western half a river lies to the south. The railway is not on the map.

clues.title: Google car: rubber in roof racks = west, empty = east
text: The roof racks of the Street View car are very useful as they can effectively split Mongolia in half. The presence of **rubber inlays** in the roof racks are generally found in the **west**, while **empty roof racks** are generally found in the **east**.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Rubber inlays in the roof racks are mostly in the west; empty racks are mostly in the east. This splits the country in half.

clues.title: Google car: spare tyre type splits four zones
text: You can split Mongolia into 4 zones based on the **spare tire** in the back right of the Street View car:
- A [netted spare tire](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.299531,93.31415,3a,76.6y,238.3h,20.06t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1swp5kUtuhYttQYsmQlK3ykQ!2e0) shown in red
- A [single strap spare tire](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.05143,113.5935221,2a,41.8y,161.19h,36.49t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1stIFUhco3k5PHsEj-RVNhNQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) shown in green
- A [spare tire with no strap](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.2198218,109.9229866,2a,80.7y,196h,29.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1stA_yWzqk0nMECryacdS9RA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) shown in orange
- [Without a spare tire](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1847345,105.0955595,3a,64y,84.71h,28.23t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sjlfb8udsJGESo5QP88DQ1w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) shown in blue
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._

images.caption: Four spare tyre types in coloured boxes, matched by colour to their zones on the map

clues.summary: The spare tyre on the back right has four types by area: netted, single strap, no strap, or none at all. See the map.

clues.title: Google car: light blue tent, forward snorkel
text: In the eastern grasslands, the Street View car has a **light blue tent** and a forward-facing snorkel.
clues.summary: In the eastern grasslands the car has a light blue tent and a snorkel pointing forward.

clues.title: Google car: orange roof straps layout
text: The eastern region can be further divided into several smaller areas based on the layout of the **orange** **roof rack straps**. These straps can be seen by looking straight down.
NOTE: Orange straps can be found in the west as well, this tip is only useful for the eastern car with a blue tent from the previous tip.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
clues.summary: The layout of the orange straps on the roof racks, seen looking straight down, splits the east into smaller areas. Only useful for the eastern blue-tent car, since the west has orange straps too.

clues.title: Google car: red tent straps at the front
text: The tent will have **red tensioner straps** at the front around the city of Chinggis.

NOTE: The [Chinggis-Baganuur highway](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.4391543,109.8378335,2a,75y,315.09h,87.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sN5SDK-MiT4-1G-o13E9Auw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) (in grey) is almost entirely hidden coverage.

images.caption: Two red circles mark the red tent straps at the front of the Google car

clues.summary: The tent has red tensioner straps at the front around one eastern town. The road to a nearby town is almost entirely hidden coverage.

clues.title: Google car: blue tent, backward-facing snorkel
text: North of Ulaanbaatar you can find this car, which has the same blue tent as the eastern tent, but with a **backwards-facing snorkel**. The snorkel can sometimes be difficult to see, so use other additional clues such as rolling hills and forests to confirm the region.

NOTE: The highway in pink can have either the blue tent car or the [tentless car with snow coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.326546,106.221693,3a,133.2y,12.7h,98.90t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1so4HCVsdnYFYZfYe2PtP_Jw!2e0).

images.caption: Red circle at left zooms in on the snorkel beside the blue tent

clues.summary: North of the capital: the same blue tent as the east but with a backward-facing snorkel, which can be hard to see. Confirm with rolling hills and forests. One highway there can have either this car or a tentless snowy one.

clues.title: Google car: no tent, near the capital
text: A Street View car with **no tent** can be seen in and around the capital city. It is generally found on a **northwest diagonal** going through Ulaanbaatar. Southeast of Ulaanbaatar, on the [Choir highway](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.310148,108.452523,3a,133.2y,132.8h,87.92t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1scj5ztc11AblLnCUYpLDlJQ!2e0), the car will have a double mirror on the left as well as a backward facing snorkel.
Driving direction is especially useful with this car as it is always travelling away from the capital.
clues.summary: A car with no tent around the capital, usually on a north-west diagonal through it. On the south-east desert road it has a double mirror on the left and a backward snorkel. It always drives away from the capital.

clues.title: Google car: bright silver tent
text: A Street View car with a **bright silver tent** is generally found in **central and northwestern** Mongolia.
NOTE: The [Bulgan Highway](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.971181,103.09039,3a,133.2y,248.8h,91.86t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPcCDXFcwTUaLMhUm1Z7Njw!2e0) (in grey) is almost entirely hidden coverage.
clues.summary: A bright silver tent is generally in the centre and north-west. One highway there is almost entirely hidden coverage.

clues.title: Google car: grey tent with hooks
text: A Street View car with a **grey tent** and **hooks **on the tent can only be found in western Mongolia. It is the most common car to have the netted spare tire.
clues.summary: A grey tent with hooks is only in the west. It is the most common car with the netted spare tyre.

clues.title: Google car: grey tent, hook straps point down
text: If the grey tent has **hook straps** **angled downwards**, you should be in southwestern Mongolia.
clues.summary: Grey tent with hook straps angled downwards means the south-west.

clues.title: Google car: grey tent, no left hooks, billowing
text: If the grey tent has **no hooks** on the left side and is **billowing **from the wind, you will be on the road between [Khovd](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.006503,91.646571,3a,133.2y,1.7h,88.38t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sMsFFaJ9MaNromzBp_vlv9g!2e0) and [Ölgii](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.951014,89.961985,3a,133.2y,334.3h,71.90t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s0aKD-w7PKQ7UbFVu3IHyPw!2e0) or around the town of [Tugrug](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.419796,92.225821,3a,132.7y,6.9h,80.61t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sR4YoP4G5lntn_0X9WJLaQA!2e0).
clues.summary: A grey tent with no hooks on the left that billows in the wind: on the road between two far-west towns or around a third nearby.

clues.title: Google car: cage on the roof, winter
text: A Street View car with a **cage** on top of the roof instead of a tent can be seen near Ulaanbaatar. West of Ulaanbaatar, the car will have a [green camouflage sleeping bag](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.8967631,105.5177786,3a,31.5y,232.36h,46.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssX7pU24XafLnwz2a_NC7ug!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) on top of the cage (coverage highlighted in green). Additionally, all coverage with this car was taken during winter, with most of it being in snowy areas.

NOTE: The cage car can very rarely appear in [Kharkhorin](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1827252,102.803768,2a,90y,224.36h,85.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sap6SFr1Io_8pnFMafcbQ-g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [Zuunmod](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.687993,106.94846,3a,133.2y,9.2h,93.60t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPDrz82bCouVh_PsjAk81QQ!2e0).
clues.summary: A cage instead of a tent, near the capital. West of the capital it has a green camouflage sleeping bag on the cage. All of it is winter, mostly snowy. It rarely appears in two nearby towns.

clues.title: Google car: silver truck, blue-white roof decal
text: Generation 4 coverage in the capital uses a** **silver truck with an **ornate blue & white** **roof decal**, with a snorkel and long antenna on the front right. While the unique roof can be seen in most locations, [some locations](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.04911,107.027365,3a,78.8y,18.0h,81.16t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1spjnBE5kV7HOlw2xVG93ytQ!2e0) blur most of the car, leaving only the snorkel and antenna visible. This car can only be found **around Ulaanbaatar**.
clues.summary: Gen 4 in the capital: a silver truck with an ornate blue and white roof decal, a snorkel and a long antenna at the front right. Sometimes only the snorkel and antenna show. Only around the capital.

clues.title: Google car: silver pickup, metal box and shovel
text: Generation 4 coverage in **eastern Mongolia** uses a silver pick-up truck with a large **metal box **and shovel on the roof. The car was sponsored by Bodi Group, however camera stitching generally hides one of the letters.
clues.summary: Gen 4 in the east: a silver pickup with a large metal box and a shovel on the roof. Sponsor lettering is often partly hidden by stitching.

clues.title: Google car: silver pickup, big light-blue tent
text: Generation 4 coverage in **western Mongolia** uses a **silver pick-up truck** with a big light blue tent. Different variations of the tent can be useful for narrowing down the region.
clues.summary: Gen 4 in the west: a silver pickup with a big light blue tent. The tent variations help narrow the region.

clues.title: Google car: tent with 2 straps, one knot
text: The tent with 2 straps and a **single knot** in the straps covers most of northwestern Mongolia.
NOTE: Occasionally, camera stitching can [hide the knot](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pFWZ5yX4uJE56xoA9).
clues.summary: A tent with two straps and one knot covers most of the north-west. Stitching can hide the knot.

clues.title: Google car: tent with a knot on both straps
text: The tent with a **knot on both straps** covers most of southwestern Mongolia.
clues.summary: A tent with a knot on both straps covers most of the south-west.

clues.title: Google car: tent with lower strap bunched up
text: The tent with the **lower strap in a clump **covers most of central-southern Mongolia, along the road from Ulaanbaatar to Altai.
clues.summary: A tent with the lower strap in a clump covers most of the centre-south, along the road from the capital to the far west.

clues.title: Google car: tent with 4 straps
text: The tent with **4 straps** covers most of central-northern Mongolia.
clues.summary: A tent with four straps covers most of the centre-north.

clues.title: Google car: tent with open zipper
text: You can find a tent with an **open zipper** in central Mongolia, near the town of Khorgo.
clues.summary: A tent with an open zipper in the centre, near one town.

clues.title: Landscape: big city, ferris wheel, cloudy winter
text: Erdenet is the second largest city in Mongolia. As such, it has many multistory buildings that can be seen from across town, a large stadium, and a **ferris wheel** in the south of the city. It is surrounded by large barren hills to the south and to the north, and was covered on a **cloudy day **in the** winter**, meaning all vegetation is dead.

NOTE: Erdenet can look very similar to Darkhan and Ulaanbaatar, but the lack of snow distinguishes it from [Darkhan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6), while the cloudy skies and lack of rubber inlays on the roof racks can be used to distinguish it from [Ulaanbaatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59).
clues.summary: The second biggest city: many tall buildings, a large stadium and a ferris wheel in the south, barren hills to the north and south. Shot on a cloudy winter day, so plants are dead. Similar to two other cities, but no snow and cloudy skies set it apart.

clues.title: Coverage: big city with snow
text: The city of Darkhan in northern Mongolia can be recognized by its distinct **snow coverage**. It is the third largest city in Mongolia and as such has many high-rising buildings and travelling cars.

NOTE: Other smaller towns can also have snow coverage but Darkhan is the only large city in Mongolia with snow coverage, apart from some [Ulaanbaatar suburbs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.066512,106.883211,3a,133.2y,313.2h,92.32t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1si8RI0T_bQ1km7-FMfeqK2w!2e0).
clues.summary: A large northern city with snow coverage and many tall buildings and cars. It is the only large city with snow, apart from some suburbs of the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: heavy overcast, dry forested hills
text: Sukhbaatar and Altanbulag are two neighbouring towns in the north near the Russian border. They have dry, forested hills all around and heavy **overcast coverage**. Sukhbaatar is completely overcast while Altanbulag is slightly less cloudy.

NOTE: [Murun](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NnM6SDXQ8Ysi9xED8) and [Choibalsan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/68m1Tx62pZ5AtmuY8) are two other towns that also have overcast coverage, but lack forested hills and have different Street View cars.
clues.summary: Two neighbouring northern towns near the border with dry forested hills all around and heavy overcast. One is completely overcast, the other a little less. Other overcast towns lack forested hills and use different cars.

clues.title: Google car: red tent straps in a flat dry town
text: Chinggis is a major town in the east with **red straps** on the front of the tent. It is a fairly dry and flat town with small hills to the north, and somewhat cloudy skies.

NOTE: [Dundburd](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9qUP3nu9x7J9cFPe7) and [Bayan-Ovoo](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wwja52Hjp9o9FdnL7) are the only other towns with the same tent, but are much smaller towns with no paved roads.
clues.summary: A major eastern town with red straps on the front of the tent, dry, flat, with small hills to the north and somewhat cloudy skies. Two other towns have the same tent but are much smaller with no paved roads.

clues.title: Landscape: concrete roads, smoke stack, wet and overcast
text: Choibalsan is the only major city to have several **concrete roads**. In most parts of the city there is a visible **smoke stack**, which is in the southeast corner of the city. It appears to have just rained as the roads are slightly wet and the sky is overcast. Additionally, you may occasionally find [unique pedestrian signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.071051,114.53028,3a,17.5y,333.1h,85.63t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1srKpPHHlyC9nza3yV3IaZ3w!2e0) with a short figure over three stripes.

images.caption: Red circles highlight the overcast sky and a smoke stack above a concrete road

clues.summary: The only major city with several concrete roads, a smoke stack in the south-east corner, wet roads and overcast skies. Sometimes a pedestrian sign with a short figure over three stripes.

clues.title: Landscape: tall building under construction, dry
text: Baruun-Urt can be identified by the** towering building under construction** in the centre of town (on the map its POI is called “Smile”) combined with the dry landscape.
NOTE: Similar buildings under construction can be found in other towns such as Chinggis but they are not as large and do not feature an** **orange tower crane like the Smile building.
clues.summary: A towering unfinished building in the town centre, with an orange tower crane, and dry land around. Smaller unfinished buildings in other towns have no orange crane.

clues.title: Landscape: giant sword statue, flat green land
text: The town of Khalkhgol in far east Mongolia can be recognized by its flat, green landscape with low rolling hills and a **giant sword statue** visible in the distance.
clues.summary: A flat green landscape with low rolling hills and a giant sword statue in the distance, in the far east.

clues.title: Landscape: distinctive hill north-west of the town
text: The town of Dariganga can be recognized by the **distinctive hill** present to the northwest of the town in an otherwise flat landscape.
clues.summary: A distinctive hill north-west of a town in an otherwise flat landscape.

clues.title: Landscape: desert town with dry ridge, mini Eiffel Tower
text: Sainshand is the largest town in the desert region and it has a dry climate, many buildings, and paved roads. A **dry ridge** separates the northern and southern parts of the town, distinguishing Sainshand from other desert towns that are mostly flat. In the downtown area you can find a miniature [pink eiffel tower](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.8922678,110.138733,3a,90y,124.45h,93.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1HmF0u7fsDOuxWWcAchIIA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
clues.summary: The largest desert town: dry climate, many buildings, paved roads, a dry ridge splitting the town in two, and a small pink Eiffel Tower downtown.

clues.title: Pole: sailboat lamp posts with golden flower pot
text: The desert town of Zamiin-Uud on the border with China has unique **sailboat lamp posts **featuring a** golden flower pot** around them. Often, white signs with Mongolian folded script can be seen attached to these lamp posts.

NOTE: The other desert towns of Choir and Sainshand look similar to Zamiin-Uud and have the same Street View car but use different lamp posts. Choir can be identified by its [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0) lamp posts and Sainshand by its [white](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0) lamp posts.

images.caption: Circles mark a sailboat-shaped lamp post and a nearby lamp on a street

clues.summary: On the southern border town: unique sailboat-shaped lamp posts with a golden flower pot, often with white signs in old vertical script. Two nearby desert towns look similar but use blue or white lamp posts.

clues.title: Google car: cloudy desert town, deep blue tent
text: Mandalgovi is a large desert town with notably **cloudy coverage**. It’s the only large desert town apart from Dalanzadgad which is not on the Choir Highway, and it has a **deep blue tent** instead of the tentless car.
clues.summary: A large, notably cloudy desert town with a deep blue tent instead of the tentless car. It is not on the main desert highway.

clues.title: Coverage: sunset in a dry fall-coloured town
text: Dalanzadgad can be easily recognised by its distinct **sunset coverage**. Additionally it has a dry climate, fall-coloured grass, rocky hills to the south, some smoke stacks, and a unique **loose tent cover** on the left side.

images.caption: Red circle marks the dark tent roll on the front of the car at a dusty junction at sunset

clues.summary: Sunset coverage, dry climate, fall-coloured grass, rocky hills to the south, some smoke stacks, and a loose tent cover on the left side.

clues.title: Landscape: warm green rolling hills, ferris wheel
text: Arvaikheer is a large central town recognizable by the **warm, green, and grassy landscape **in gen 4, with low rolling hills in every direction. Often you can see the town’s [ferris wheel](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RzBqinKz157B8kS19) in a park in the centre of town.

NOTE: In older coverage, a distinct [camera smudge](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) can be seen on the right side of the camera.
clues.summary: A large central town with a warm, green, grassy landscape in Gen 4 and low rolling hills in every direction. A ferris wheel stands in a park in the centre. Older coverage has a smudge on the right of the camera.

clues.title: Landscape: big dry hill with a symbol carved on it
text: The town of Bayankhongor, in central Mongolia, has an overall dry landscape and can be recognized from the nearby **large dry hill to the east,** with the Soyombo symbol inscribed onto it.

NOTE: In older coverage, a distinct [camera smudge](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.2622102,102.7889926,2a,63.4y,51.57h,74.46t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1szEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fcb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile%26w%3D900%26h%3D600%26pitch%3D15.543539424258526%26panoid%3DzEP8_kTHn13duwL0QbVMrQ%26yaw%3D51.569379852417136!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205410&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI0MDkwNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) can be seen on the right side of the camera.
clues.summary: A central town with an overall dry landscape and a large dry hill to the east carved with a national symbol. Older coverage has a smudge on the right side of the camera.

clues.title: Landscape: rocky rugged hills with small trees, clear sky
text: In the central town of Tsetserleg, you will see these distinct **rocky**, **rugged hills,** with small trees growing on them to the north. It has very clear skies and the neighbourhoods can often be seen on the hilly slopes.
clues.summary: Distinct rocky, rugged hills with small trees to the north, very clear skies, and neighbourhoods visible on the slopes.

clues.title: Landscape: grid town, jagged hill, dark cloudy skies
text: Murun is a town in the north built on a **north-south grid** with a large **jagged hill** nearby to the north. It has a lot of [alley coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1ee2vK8QRRt4qKaE7) with **dark cloudy skies** and muddy, unpaved roads.

NOTE: Murun occasionally has [sunny cove](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.6423593,100.1496062,3a,90y,2.1h,92.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sI85UCATaKh7RFhDn3cd4UQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)[rage](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.6423593,100.1496062,3a,90y,2.1h,92.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sI85UCATaKh7RFhDn3cd4UQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) where it isn’t cloudy, so consider other clues as well.
clues.summary: A northern town laid out on a north-south grid with a large jagged hill to the north, dark cloudy skies and muddy unpaved roads. Sunny coverage exists occasionally.

clues.title: Coverage: autumn colours and a big lake
text: Hatgal is a small lake town on the Khuvsgul Lake. It can be recognized from its **fall coverage **with orange trees and grass, and the **large lake** in the northeast, where the [Khuvsgul Ice Festival](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.5022757,100.1660243,2a,90y,292.3h,91.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8IxMX1A7ghnXLvz5ONqe4Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) is held every year.
clues.summary: A small lake town with orange autumn trees and grass, and the large lake to the north-east.

clues.title: Pole: wavy lamp posts, red-tinted roads
text: The small, hilly town of Tosontsengel, frequently has **red-tinted roads** and uses these unique lamp posts that have a **wavy design**.
clues.summary: A small hilly town with red-tinted roads and unique wavy-design lamp posts.

clues.title: Landscape: green hills around a town, river, symbol hill
text: Uliastai is a central-western Mongolian town, **surrounded by** **large, green nearby hills**. It is common to see a decent amount of **trees **or the **river **that runs through the town. In the centre of town, you can find a small [hill](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fi4Q82dtsDEW8Ho26) with the Soyombo symbol inscribed on it.
clues.summary: A west-central town surrounded by large green hills, with many trees and a river through it. A small hill in the centre has a national symbol carved on it.

clues.title: Landscape: dark distant hills S and W, wet roads
text: In the town of Altai, you can see a **range of dark, distant hills** to the south and west and low rolling hills to the north and east. Additionally, it is common to see wet roads, as most of the coverage occurred after heavy rain.

NOTE: In older coverage, a unique tent can be seen, which is [inflated](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.374901,96.262533,3a,133.2y,68.9h,87.04t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1slzvGw8d1cow1dkNhDgMF0w!2e0) on the left side.
clues.summary: A town with dark distant hills to the south and west and low rolling hills to the north and east. Roads are often wet after heavy rain. Older coverage shows a tent inflated on the left.

clues.title: Landscape: red rocky hills north of a dry shrubby town
text: Khovd is a large, dry and shrubby town, in western Mongolia, that can be identified by the very distinct **rocky, red-tinted hills,** present to the** **north of town.

NOTE: The nearby [Khar-Us](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AM8e1gaheeFvUP5X9), [Tugrug](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NipvfyEBDZw75eLNA), and the samely named [Khovd](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gg2oVW2ZVEnLyzZ17) have similar landscapes but are much smaller towns.
clues.summary: A large dry, shrubby town in the west, with very distinct rocky, red-tinted hills to the north. Nearby smaller towns look similar.

clues.title: Landscape: close dry rocky mountains, red-white tower
text: Ölgii is a large town in the west, that is **surrounded by close, dry rocky mountains**. Towards the south end of town, there is a tall **red & white radio tower,** that can be seen from all across town and is quite distinct to Ölgii.
clues.summary: A large western town surrounded by close, dry, rocky mountains, with a tall red and white radio tower at the south end that is visible across town.

clues.title: Pole: double lamp posts with blue or green base
text: Ulaangom is a northwestern town with **large, distant, dark mountains** to the southwest. Additionally, these distinct **double lamp posts **with a blue or green painted base can frequently be seen in Ulaangom.

NOTE: Rarely, double lamp posts can be found in other cities such as [Baruun-Urt](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.6824863,113.27728,2a,45.8y,266.42h,95.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8wyWiMi85Yc9lq0p5Fc6MQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [Chinggis](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.3156,110.657067,3a,79.3y,6.0h,89.88t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s37JBTksYabYNoiTdGCsv-Q!2e0), but these towns have flat landscapes.
clues.summary: A north-western town with large, distant dark mountains to the south-west, and double lamp posts with a blue or green base. Two flat eastern towns rarely have double lamp posts too.

clues.title: Coverage: glaciers and snowy peaks, bag on roof racks
text: In the westmost part of Mongolia, there is some very remote coverage showcasing the tallest mountains in Mongolia where you can see glaciers and **snow-capped peaks**. This area also has a unique Street View car with a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.
clues.summary: Very remote coverage in the far west showing the tallest mountains with glaciers and snow-capped peaks. The car has a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.

clues.title: Landscape: small shrubs, patchy grass, flat
text: East of Uvs lake, you can find a lot of these **small shrubs** and patchy grass in a somewhat flat landscape.

NOTE: Similar shrubs can be found around [Shaazgai Lake](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.234698,91.23369,3a,133.2y,93.5h,88.52t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sp0fw9T6Pm6c030-i807Nmw!2e0), but that area is considerably more hilly.
clues.summary: Many small shrubs and patchy grass in a fairly flat landscape, east of a big western lake. A similar area near another lake is much hillier.

clues.title: Landscape: dense forest, dark soil, grey tent
text: Khan Khokhii is a national park in northwestern Mongolia with some of the most **dense forests** in the country. It has partially cloudy skies, dark soil, and the western grey tent.
Keep in mind that the trails in this park do not appear on the map.
NOTE: There are other forests in Mongolia, but Khan Khokhii is one of the biggest and one of the only areas where you can be completely surrounded by trees.
clues.summary: A national park in the north-west with some of the densest forests, partly cloudy skies, dark soil and the western grey tent. Its trails are not on the map. You can be fully surrounded by trees here.

clues.title: Landscape: bright orange sand and dunes
text: The Gobi Gurvan Saikhan National Park, in the far south of Mongolia, features **bright orange sand** and **sand dunes**. There are two separate spots covered in the park: one in the middle just north of Sevrei, which has [distant southern mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jjXtYWfWCBWUuSgs9), and the other in the far southwest corner of the park, which has a [Jeep follow car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cHgJsPAW8xUFrK8s9).
clues.summary: In the far south: bright orange sand and dunes. Two spots: one with distant southern mountains, and one in the far south-west with a Jeep follow car.

clues.title: Coverage: extremely foggy, dark soil and hills
text: Yolyn Am Valley is located just west of Dalanzadgad and can be identified by the **extremely foggy** coverage, and having dark coloured soil and hills.
clues.summary: Extremely foggy photos with dark soil and hills, in a valley west of one southern town.

clues.title: Landscape: pebble-covered ground, cliffs, forest
text: This beautiful river valley, just west of Lake Hatgal in the Khoridol Saridag mountains, is very recognizable from the surrounding rocky cliffs and forests, and the ground that is completely **covered in pebbles**.
clues.summary: A river valley with rocky cliffs and forest, and ground completely covered in pebbles.

clues.title: Coverage: four areas of night photos
text: Mongolia has four main areas of **nighttime coverage**. Those areas are:
- [Northwest of Murun](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.665052,100.104881,3a,133.2y,99.2h,93.51t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1saYeO0tBH8g2jP28milZAoA!2e0)
- [West of Dashbalbar](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.5390978,114.3529966,2a,90y,80.1h,94.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s88vnRtsAvUQvQ5nbInpglA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)
- [South of Baruun-Urt](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.3570296,113.2643332,2a,90y,331h,94.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sN-vyn4YWcXxUkk-jUgLNBA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)
- [East of Dariganga](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.290032,113.981427,3a,133.2y,285.1h,90.48t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sP1VOapJbiPpujrZB8mBk5A!2e0)
All of these locations are **driving towards town**. Driving direction and car meta can help identify which area of nighttime coverage you are in.
clues.summary: Four main areas have night coverage, all driving towards a town: north-west, west, south and east. Driving direction and the car help tell them apart.

clues.title: Coverage: rainstorm with dark skies and raindrops
text: East of the town of Khorgo there is a large stretch of road which was driven during a **rainstorm**. It features much darker skies, rain drops on the camera, and occasionally a [rainbow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/vkb8YnCWpfgv819s7) can be seen.
clues.summary: A long road stretch driven in a rainstorm: much darker skies, raindrops on the camera, and sometimes a rainbow.

clues.title: Coverage: sunset into night, driving east
text: On a road in northeastern Mongolia, the Google car drove through sunset into nighttime. There is a second road in the southeast with sunset coverage, which can be distinguished by the driving angle: this one goes east, the one in the South goes north.

images.caption: Four thumbnails of a road going from sunset into night

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: On a north-eastern road the car drives from sunset into night. A similar sunset road in the south-east can be told apart by direction: this one goes east.

clues.title: Google car: tent with two neat straps, no knots
text: West of Altai until about Sharga, the Google car in Gen 4 has its tent tied down with two neatly packed straps, no knots. Info from fuzziejaxer's doc

images.caption: Tent on the car roof with two neat straps and no knots

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: Gen 4 west of one far-west town to about another: the tent is tied with two neat straps and no knots.

clues.title: Google car: two straps with messy knot, zipper far left
text: Between Altai and Bayankhongor, Gen 4 coverage will have two straps with a messy knot. While further east, the zipper tag is a bit more central, on this part of the road it is all the way left. Info from fuzziejaxer's doc

images.caption: Orange circle marks the messy knot on the left of the two tent straps
